verdict.rationale: TaxJar's own marketing shows economic nexus tracking that measures both sales and transaction counts against a threshold ("$90k of $100k", "125 of 200"). Its support docs describe a tool that pinpoints states where thresholds have already been met. That covers the US-state tracking core, but there is no documented proactive alert before a threshold is crossed, and TaxJar is positioned as US-only, so country thresholds are not covered. missing for 10: documented pre-threshold alerting/notifications, country-level (non-US) threshold tracking, confirmation that all states are tracked, in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration of the nexus tracker.

support.subject: As a founder, the product watches my economic nexus exposure — tracking sales and transaction counts against every state and country threshold and alerting me before I cross one, not after

citations.quote: Tracking Economic Nexus Sales threshold: $90k of $100k Transaction threshold: 125 of 200
This tool will pinpoint states where you've met economic nexus thresholds.
Built for small and medium-sized businesses that only sell in the US and are not using Stripe.
